dct_title_s: Carte du Royaume de Danemarc / par Guill. Del'Isle de l'Academie Royale des Science.
dct_description_sm: Manuscript "11" in upper right corner of map.; Shows forests, rivers, lakes, national borders, cities, and towns. Depicts Denmark, part of northern Germany, part of southern Sweden, and a small portion of northwestern Poland.; Relief shown pictorially.; Copperplate engraving. Borders and urban areas hand colored.; Title and statement of responsibility above upper neat line. Publication information below lower neat line in left corner. Georgraphic scale below lower neat line in right corner.; Separated from a pre-1732 edition of Guillaume de L'Isle's "Atlas de géographie."
1 map : copperplate engraving, hand colored 48 x 62 cm
dct_creator_sm: Contained in (work): L'Isle, Guillaume de, 1675-1726. Atlas de géographie
dct_subject_sm: Baltic Sea Maps Early works to 1800.
